the_merchant.name: The Merchant
the_merchant.title: Keeper of the World Market
the_merchant.greeting: Welcome to the World Market, $C. Buy from every adventurer in the realm — or set out your own wares and let coin find you.

marshal_redbrook.name: Marshal Redbrook
marshal_redbrook.title: Town Marshal
marshal_redbrook.greeting: Keep your blade close, $C. The Vale is not what it was.

trader_wilkes.name: Trader Wilkes
trader_wilkes.title: Provisioner
trader_wilkes.greeting: Fresh bread, clean water, fair prices. What can I get you?

apothecary_lin.name: Apothecary Lin
apothecary_lin.title: Herbalist
apothecary_lin.greeting: Careful where you step in the eastern woods, friend.

brother_aldric.name: Brother Aldric
brother_aldric.title: Priest of the Vale
brother_aldric.greeting: The Light keep you. Even the dead find no rest here of late.

smith_haldren.name: Smith Haldren
smith_haldren.title: Armorer & Weaponsmith
smith_haldren.greeting: Mind the sparks, $C. Good steel is the difference between a scar and a grave.

fisherman_brandt.name: Fisherman Brandt
fisherman_brandt.title: Old Salt
fisherman_brandt.greeting: Blrb-glub— sorry, been listening to those fish-men too long.

foreman_odell.name: Foreman Odell
foreman_odell.title: Mine Foreman
foreman_odell.greeting: Whole dig's crawling with those dirt-caked vermin!

bursar_fernando.name: Bursar Fernando
bursar_fernando.title: The Gilded Strongbox
bursar_fernando.greeting: Welcome to the Gilded Strongbox. Your goods rest safe behind our locks.

card_master.name: Card Master
card_master.title: Dealer of Chance
card_master.greeting: Care for a Card Duel? Best of three, winner takes the bragging rights.

groundskeeper_bram.name: Groundskeeper Bram
groundskeeper_bram.title: Keeper of the Sowfield
groundskeeper_bram.greeting: The truce holds at the Sowfield, $C: boots and shoulders only. Care to play for the Copper Pail?

chronicler_saul.name: Saul the Chronicler
chronicler_saul.title: The Vale Chronicle
chronicler_saul.greeting: Every deed worth doing is worth writing down twice, $N: once for the ledger and once for the fireside.

forgemistress_darva.name: Forgemistress Darva
forgemistress_darva.title: Master of the Forge
forgemistress_darva.greeting: The forge answers to me, $C. Bring good ore and it will answer to you too.

cook_marlow.name: Cook Marlow
cook_marlow.title: Master of the Kitchens
cook_marlow.greeting: Nothing leaves my kitchens half-cooked, $C. Sit, eat, then get back out there.

weaver_ottilie.name: Weaver Ottilie
weaver_ottilie.title: Master of the Loom
weaver_ottilie.greeting: Mind the threads, $C. A steady hand at the loom beats a strong one.

tinker_gizzel.name: Tinker Gizzel
tinker_gizzel.title: Master of the Toolworks
tinker_gizzel.greeting: Springs, sprockets, and sharp edges, $C: the toolworks has whatever your hands lack.

warden_fenwick.name: Warden Fenwick
warden_fenwick.title: Warden of Fenbridge
warden_fenwick.greeting: Hold at the gate, $C. Past those reeds, the fen does the killing for us.

brother_aldric_fen.name: Brother Aldric
brother_aldric_fen.title: Priest of the Vale
brother_aldric_fen.greeting: The Light keep you above the water, $N. The dead in this fen do not sleep — they wade.

provisioner_hale.name: Provisioner Hale
provisioner_hale.title: Provisioner
provisioner_hale.greeting: Dry boots, dry bread, dry powder — at Fenbridge you get two of the three on a good day.

herbalist_yara.name: Herbalist Yara
herbalist_yara.title: Herbalist
herbalist_yara.greeting: Mind the thicket west of the road. The webs are thick as sailcloth this season.

scout_maren.name: Scout Maren
scout_maren.title: Marshal's Scout
scout_maren.greeting: Quiet feet and a short blade keep you breathing out here. Speak quick — I am due back in the reeds.

bursar_petra_vell.name: Bursar Petra Vell
bursar_petra_vell.title: The Gilded Strongbox
bursar_petra_vell.greeting: The Gilded Strongbox keeps clean ledgers and cleaner vaults. What shall we stow for you?

chronicler_osric_fenn.name: Chronicler Osric Fenn
chronicler_osric_fenn.title: The Marsh Chronicle
chronicler_osric_fenn.greeting: Mind the damp on the pages, $N. The fen eats more books than readers ever will.

tanner_hesk.name: Tanner Hesk
tanner_hesk.title: Master of the Tannery
tanner_hesk.greeting: A hide is only as good as its tanning, $C. The vats are ready when you are.

captain_thessaly.name: Captain Thessaly
captain_thessaly.title: Highwatch Captain
captain_thessaly.greeting: Two hundred years this wall has held, $C. It will not break on my watch — but it groans.

brother_aldric_highwatch.name: Brother Aldric
brother_aldric_highwatch.title: Priest of the Vale
brother_aldric_highwatch.greeting: From a chapel yard in the Vale to the roof of the world... the trail we have followed ends here. I can feel the mountain listening.

brother_aldric_raid.name: Brother Aldric
brother_aldric_raid.title: Priest of the Vale
brother_aldric_raid.greeting: From a chapel yard in the Vale to the roof of the world... the trail we have followed ends here. I can feel the mountain listening.

scout_maren_highwatch.name: Scout Maren
scout_maren_highwatch.title: Marshal's Scout
scout_maren_highwatch.greeting: I tracked cultists through the fen at your side, and the trail led here. The peaks are worse, $C. Stay sharp.

quartermaster_bree.name: Quartermaster Bree
quartermaster_bree.title: Highwatch Quartermaster
quartermaster_bree.greeting: Wool, hardtack, and steel-shod boots — Highwatch runs on all three, and I am short of everything.

armorer_hode.name: Armorer Hode
armorer_hode.title: Master Armorer
armorer_hode.greeting: Forge is hot and the grindstone is turning. If it cuts, I sell it.

heroic_quartermaster.name: Quartermaster Vex
heroic_quartermaster.title: Heroic Quartermaster
heroic_quartermaster.greeting: Proof of the heroic depths buys the finest rings and pendants in Highwatch. Show me your marks.

warmarshal_draven_kole.name: Warmarshal Draven Kole
warmarshal_draven_kole.title: Master of the Warfare Stores
warmarshal_draven_kole.greeting: Honor is the only coin I take, and the Warfare stores are mine to guard. Earn your rank on the field and I will armor you for the next one.

loremaster_caddis.name: Loremaster Caddis
loremaster_caddis.title: Loremaster
loremaster_caddis.greeting: Mind the loose shale, $C. The mountain has been... restless of late. I intend to learn why.

auctioneer_voss.name: Auctioneer Voss
auctioneer_voss.title: Keeper of the World Market
auctioneer_voss.greeting: The World Market is open here too, $C. Buy from every adventurer in the realm, or set out your own wares.

bursar_aldous_crane.name: Bursar Aldous Crane
bursar_aldous_crane.title: The Gilded Strongbox
bursar_aldous_crane.greeting: Every crate, coffer, and trinket is safe with the Gilded Strongbox.

stablemaster_marla.name: Marla Hitchen
stablemaster_marla.title: Stablemaster
stablemaster_marla.greeting: Every rider walks in on two legs, $C. I will not hand you the reins until you can sit the Valorsteed without kissing the dirt, and the Galecrest wind shows no mercy to a bad seat.

chronicler_edda_hartwell.name: Chronicler Zenzie
chronicler_edda_hartwell.title: The Peaks Chronicle
chronicler_edda_hartwell.greeting: The mountain forgets nothing, $N, and neither do I. Let us see what you have done.

alchemist_verane.name: Alchemist Verane
alchemist_verane.title: Master of the Apothecary
alchemist_verane.greeting: Measure twice and pour once, $C. The apothecary has no patience for spilled reagents.

tidewatcher_ondrel.name: Ondrel Vane
tidewatcher_ondrel.title: Tidewatcher
tidewatcher_ondrel.greeting: The mere drinks the moonlight, $C, and gives back the drowned. I have watched that gate for thirty nights — and tonight it is open.

fury.name: FURY
fury.title: Honor Quartermaster
fury.greeting: The sands remember every victory. Spend your honor well.

brother_halven.name: Brother Halven
brother_halven.title: Reliquary Keeper
brother_halven.greeting: The reliquary below has shifted again.

brother_halven_marsh.name: Brother Halven
brother_halven_marsh.title: Reliquary Keeper
brother_halven_marsh.greeting: The trail led north. Another reliquary, another rite. Choose your tier, and I'll hold the rope until you return.

keeper_saelwyn.name: Keeper Saelwyn
keeper_saelwyn.title: Keeper of the Hollow
keeper_saelwyn.greeting: Few of your kind have stood beneath these boughs, $C. Walk gently, and be welcome.

loremother_bryn.name: Loremother Bryn
loremother_bryn.title: Voice of the Shrine
loremother_bryn.greeting: Every light in this valley remembers something, $N. Help me listen.

provisioner_fenna.name: Provisioner Fenna
provisioner_fenna.title: Eldergleam Provisioner
provisioner_fenna.greeting: Bread still warm, water still sweet. The Hollow provides, and so do I.

wardsmith_orun.name: Wardsmith Orun
wardsmith_orun.title: Keeper of the Old Forges
wardsmith_orun.greeting: These forges cooled centuries ago, $C, but their work still holds an edge.

archivist_tullo.name: Archivist Tullo
archivist_tullo.title: Reader of Stones
archivist_tullo.greeting: The monuments out there have not spoken to anyone in an age. Perhaps they were waiting for fresh ears.

huntsman_deral.name: Huntsman Deral
huntsman_deral.title: Warden of the Herds
huntsman_deral.greeting: Quiet now. The herd knows every sound this valley makes, and so do I.

gatecaptain_brannoc.name: Gatecaptain Brannoc
gatecaptain_brannoc.title: Commander of Wyrmwatch
gatecaptain_brannoc.greeting: Wyrmwatch holds the gate. Has held it forty years. It will hold it tonight.

quartermaster_sela.name: Quartermaster Sela
quartermaster_sela.title: Keeper of the Garrison Stores
quartermaster_sela.greeting: Every crate in this yard crossed forty miles of ash to get here. Treat them kindly.

scout_yerrin.name: Scout Yerrin
scout_yerrin.title: Far-Dune Watcher
scout_yerrin.greeting: Keep low. Sound carries strangely off the glass, and the gate below has ears.

warden_kaldra.name: Warden Kaldra
warden_kaldra.title: Warden of Icemantle
warden_kaldra.greeting: Mind the benches, stranger. The snow keeps what it takes.

hearthkeeper_maeve.name: Hearthkeeper Maeve
hearthkeeper_maeve.title: Keeper of the Hearth-Lodge
hearthkeeper_maeve.greeting: Come in off the cold. The lodge fire never goes out, so long as I draw breath.

scout_einna.name: Scout Einna
scout_einna.title: Snowline Scout
scout_einna.greeting: You walked the pass alive. Good. Icemantle should hear of it.

aurorist_veyla.name: Aurorist Veyla
aurorist_veyla.title: Reader of the Lights
aurorist_veyla.greeting: Hush. The lights are speaking tonight, and they do not repeat themselves.

trapper_brosk.name: Trapper Brosk
trapper_brosk.title: Shiverfen Trapper
trapper_brosk.greeting: Fen took three of my lines this week. Fen never took a line in twenty years.

reeve_ottoline.name: Reeve Ottoline
reeve_ottoline.title: Reeve of Lanternmere
reeve_ottoline.greeting: Welcome to Lanternmere, where the harvest never ends and neither does the work.

waywatcher_sorrel.name: Waywatcher Sorrel
waywatcher_sorrel.title: Watcher of the Goldmelt
waywatcher_sorrel.greeting: Snow behind you, gold ahead. Few walk the Goldmelt twice, so make the crossing count.

ferrymaster_caddow.name: Ferrymaster Caddow
ferrymaster_caddow.title: Keeper of the Lantern Ferries
ferrymaster_caddow.greeting: Fog is on the Mere again. When the lanterns go out on the water, wise folk stay ashore.

orchardist_pomeline.name: Orchardist Pomeline
orchardist_pomeline.title: Keeper of the Gilded Rows
orchardist_pomeline.greeting: Mind where you step. Every root in these rows is older than the town, and they remember.

waykeeper_pell.name: Waykeeper Pell
waykeeper_pell.title: Keeper of the Amberfen Steps
waykeeper_pell.greeting: Down the Steps and into the soft country. Mind where you plant your boots.

bridgewright_alden.name: Bridgewright Alden
bridgewright_alden.title: Master of the Fenway
bridgewright_alden.greeting: Every plank in this town is mine to keep, and the fen chews on all of them.

netter_maris.name: Netter Maris
netter_maris.title: Eel-Netter of Bridgemere
netter_maris.greeting: Smell that? Smoked eel. Half this town stands on stilts I bought with it.

mother_sedge.name: Mother Sedge
mother_sedge.title: Fen-Witch of Willowweep
mother_sedge.greeting: The willows told me you were coming before your boots left the bridge.

lamplighter_sorrel.name: Lamplighter Sorrel
lamplighter_sorrel.title: Keeper of the Nightgate
lamplighter_sorrel.greeting: Mind the lamps, friend. Past this gate the sun gives up and the flowers take over.

lira_dewsong.name: Lira Dewsong
lira_dewsong.title: Night-Gardener of Moonrest
lira_dewsong.greeting: Welcome to Moonrest, where the flowers do our dawning for us.

weaver_amelle.name: Weaver Amelle
weaver_amelle.title: Moonfleece Weaver
weaver_amelle.greeting: Feel that? Moonfleece on the loom. Warmer than any fire you have sat beside.

astronomer_cassian.name: Astronomer Cassian
astronomer_cassian.title: Watcher at the Vigil
astronomer_cassian.greeting: Hush now. The sky never dawns here, so it never stops talking either.

lampman_cobb.name: Lampman Cobb
lampman_cobb.title: Keeper of the Crowgate Lanterns
lampman_cobb.greeting: Stay in the lamplight, friend. The wood counts everyone who passes the gate.

sexton_marrow.name: Sexton Marrow
sexton_marrow.title: Sexton of Gallowmere
sexton_marrow.greeting: We bury them deep here, and we ring the bells so they remember to stay down.

widow_tansy.name: Widow Tansy
widow_tansy.title: Candlewright of Gallowmere
widow_tansy.greeting: A candle for every grave, and not one may go out. Not one, do you hear me?

vicar_creel.name: Vicar Creel
vicar_creel.title: Last Vicar of the Mournstone
vicar_creel.greeting: The chapel fell years ago. The dead beneath it did not notice, and so I stayed.

strandwatcher_pell.name: Strandwatcher Pell
strandwatcher_pell.title: Watcher of the Tanglemouth
strandwatcher_pell.greeting: Out of the black trees at last. Breathe, stranger, the sun holds this side of the pass.

salvage_boss_ryna.name: Salvage-Boss Ryna
salvage_boss_ryna.title: Mistress of the Wreck Line
salvage_boss_ryna.greeting: A $C with working arms, good. The wreck line pays well, if the crabs leave you enough fingers to count it.

pearlmother_isha.name: Pearl-Mother Isha
pearlmother_isha.title: Elder of the Divers
pearlmother_isha.greeting: The sea gives, the sand keeps, and the jungle takes. Stay on the strand, stranger.

hermit_okku.name: Okku
hermit_okku.title: The Man Who Went In
hermit_okku.greeting: Quiet now. The drums count everything that walks under the trees, and they have already counted you.

gatewarden_pell.name: Gatewarden Pell
gatewarden_pell.title: Keeper of the Garden Gate
gatewarden_pell.greeting: Mind how you go on the lawns. The garden keeps them trimmed, and it likes them tidy.

head_gardener_amaranth.name: Head Gardener Amaranth
head_gardener_amaranth.title: Head Gardener of the Evergarden
head_gardener_amaranth.greeting: Do not mind the shadows under my eyes. Someone has to stay awake while the garden dreams.

wickmother_sorrel.name: Wickmother Sorrel
wickmother_sorrel.title: Keeper of the Hedgewick Inn
wickmother_sorrel.greeting: Come in, sit, there is cordial on the fire. Just keep a hand on anything iron: the gnomes are light-fingered of late.

gardener_yew.name: Gardener Yew
gardener_yew.title: The Last Gardener
gardener_yew.greeting: Hand me that barrow, would you? These lawns do not walk themselves, whatever the hamlet thinks.

watcher_maren.name: Watcher Maren
watcher_maren.title: The Windway Watch
watcher_maren.greeting: Mind your footing past the gate. The wind up here takes hats first and questions never.

harbormaster_odile.name: Harbormaster Odile
harbormaster_odile.title: Harbormaster of Wickharbor
harbormaster_odile.greeting: Every boat in this cove owes the Old Beacon its keel. Speak quick, the tide will not wait.

keeper_bram.name: Keeper Bram
keeper_bram.title: Keeper of the Old Beacon
keeper_bram.greeting: Nine and thirty years this lamp has burned on my watch. It will not go dark on yours.

salvager_edda.name: Salvager Edda
salvager_edda.title: Wreckfield Salvager
salvager_edda.greeting: Wreckwood, rope, and dead men's cargo. The sea pays my wage, when the Warden lets it.

warden_coalfast.name: Warden Coalfast
warden_coalfast.title: Redoubt Commander
warden_coalfast.greeting: The breaks do not care that Gullhaven is small, $C. We hold this shore, or there is no shore left to hold. Stand with us and I will not forget it.

riftwatch_ollun.name: Riftwatch Ollun
riftwatch_ollun.title: Breach Scholar
riftwatch_ollun.greeting: Every break sings before it opens, if you have the ear for it. I can hear three of them stirring on the island right now, and one of them is close.

quartermaster_edda.name: Quartermaster Edda
quartermaster_edda.title: Redoubt Armorer
quartermaster_edda.greeting: Steel and salt, $C, it is all I have left to hand out. Take it and make the breaks regret opening where I could reach them.

mender_saul.name: Mender Saul
mender_saul.title: Field Surgeon
mender_saul.greeting: I have set more bones this one month than in ten years of mending fishing falls. The breaks do not leave much of what they take. Come back to me whole, if you can manage it.

bellkeeper_tam.name: Bellkeeper Tam
bellkeeper_tam.title: Watchbell Keeper
bellkeeper_tam.greeting: The bell is the only warning the breaks give us, $C. One toll for the fields, two for the cliffs, three when it is close enough that running will not help. Keep an ear on it, and it may keep you whole.

fisher_nell.name: Frightened Nell
fisher_nell.title: Gullhaven Fisher
fisher_nell.greeting: It opened right where the nets dry. Right there, where I stood every morning of my life. I do not go down to the shore anymore. I do not go much of anywhere anymore.

spirit_healer.name: The Pale Keeper
spirit_healer.title: Warden of the Dead
spirit_healer.greeting: Rest now, spirit. I can return you to your body, but the crossing back leaves you weak.
